head: Typefully now lets you add up to 20 photos and videos to an X post
dek: The post scheduler Typefully raised its limit for a single X post from four to 20 photos, videos and GIFs, and teams can now schedule quotes of a post before the original goes out. Typefully added both on 18 November.
details: The 20-item limit also covers drafts made through Typefully's API and its MCP connection. A scheduled quote is set with a delay, such as 30 minutes after the post, and can come from any account set in the workspace. If the post is rescheduled or goes out early, its quotes follow; if it's deleted, they stay as posts of their own. Quotes work on X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon and Substack.
where: Typefully on the web, for X posts; scheduled quotes on six networks, out now
means: If you post photo dumps or product shots to X through Typefully, one post can now hold up to 20 of them instead of four.
todo: In the editor, use the Quote button (Repost on LinkedIn), pick the account, write the quote and set its delay.
